intuition: Every closing bracket must match the most recent unmatched opening bracket.

brute_force.approach: Repeatedly remove adjacent matching bracket pairs until no more pairs can be removed.

optimal.approach: Push opening brackets onto a stack; each closing bracket must match and pop the stack top.

edge_cases: A closing bracket with an empty stack is immediately invalid.
A nonempty stack at the end means one or more openings were unmatched.
